title: The worker brief's always-in-scope rule tells a content worker to add a source row its touches may not cover, so done refuses _sources.csv
goal: The fixed brief rule of bl_dispatch.WORKER_RULES says a source row is in scope only in a file the item's touches name (always_in_scope holds the coverage files, not _sources.csv), or _sources.csv rows a content item adds count as in scope, so a worker that follows the brief is not refused at done

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_base,bl_dispatch;t=' '.join(str(r) for r in bl_dispatch.WORKER_RULES);sys.exit(0 if bl_base.in_scope('kb/public/_sources.csv',['kb/public/gitlab/foo.md']) or 'source row in a file the touches name' in t else 1)

notes: Merged from ST-4q4zv34i “A sprint's goal research story whose questions may add DOC facts has its root's _sources.csv in its touches” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: No code names _sources.csv (grep of bl_plan/bl_base/bl_land/bl_dispatch); pack for 'may a research item add source rows outside its touches' reads weak, so the check fails; same defect as BG-6bb4zzdy (source rows outside touches). Carrier must absorb: a goal research story naming a root's article has that root's _sources.csv in touches (or its rows count as in scope) and the _self rules answer the question with a good pack. Its goal: new sprint (or planning) gives a goal research story that names a kb root's article the root's _sources.csv in its touches, and the _self rules answer 'may a research item add source rows outside its touches' with a good pack; SP-4o3plg4l's research ST-z7eii5h6 stopped with three DOC facts and their source rows unlanded until the orchestrator widened its touches and resumed it (a second session, about 2.9 USD more) Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import subprocess,sys;t=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','may a research item add source rows outside its touches'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;print(t.splitlines()[0] if t else None);sys.exit(0 if t.startswith('coverage: good') else 1)"]}
